The [[Albino Rat]] is a [[charmable animal]] found in many areas in the [[Depths of Tyria]]. It looks like the [[Jahai Rat]] except for its white fur, red eyes and larger size. Albino Rats, pale due to the lack of pigment in their skin, eyes, and fur, are the largest known rodents on [[Tyria (world)|Tyria]] and will "eat anything and live long, healthy lives."
